headline: Anthropic & OpenAI Move AI From Software to Physical Machines—Direct Threat to Research Platforms
bottomLine: Competitors are shifting AI from research-support tools to autonomous experiment execution via hardware standards and direct scientist access, fundamentally threatening Elsevier's role as research intermediary.

whyItMatters: Elsevier's core value proposition—being the central research discovery and validation platform—is under structural attack. Competitors now offer direct-to-researcher AI, autonomous experiment execution, and vertical-specific workflows that eliminate the need for traditional abstract/citation intermediaries.
